reply: {"title":"Reviewing an Investigation Draft","setting":"At a forward operating base, during an Army AR 15-6 investigation of a corporal’s death involving the 2nd Battalion and 75th Ranger Regiment.","decider":"The regimental commander","agent_recast":false,"recast_note":"","agent":"The regimental commander","agent_role":"decide","situation":"The Commander had directed an AR 15-6 investigation into a corporal’s death and received a battalion investigating officer’s draft. The draft included findings and diagrams and identified friendly fire, while the battalion commander considered it in need of editing. A major who reviewed the draft identified gaps concerning interviews and responsibility for splitting the platoon. The Commander’s review raised questions about whether the draft explained its conclusions and whether the incident involved friendly fire alone or also enemy fire. The scope of the inquiry was understood to include another soldier’s death and the wounding of two service members.","question":"What should the Commander do with the battalion investigator’s draft and the pending AR 15-6 inquiry?","facts":[{"id":"F1","kind":"intelligence","status":"assessed","fact":"The battalion investigator’s draft concluded that the incident resulted from friendly fire, but a major assessed that it did not fully address responsibility for splitting the platoon or that action’s role in the incident.","spans":["src:c6e54c0e15c9#p24.2"]},{"id":"F2","kind":"capability","status":"assessed","fact":"The major assessed that the draft did not sufficiently address interviews about splitting the platoon and attributed the gaps to the investigating officer’s lack of experience.","spans":["src:c6e54c0e15c9#p24.2"]},{"id":"F3","kind":"situation","status":"assessed","fact":"The battalion commander considered the draft in need of editing and finalization, while also believing its contents showed that the corporal died by friendly fire.","spans":["src:c6e54c0e15c9#p24.6"]},{"id":"F4","kind":"intelligence","status":"assessed","fact":"The Commander considered the draft incomplete and insufficiently supported, with conclusions not clearly explained or supported by witness statements; he remained uncertain what happened and considered that friendly fire might have been mixed with enemy fire.","spans":["src:c6e54c0e15c9#p25.5"]},{"id":"F5","kind":"situation","status":"assessed","fact":"The Commander understood that the inquiry should encompass not only the corporal’s death but also the death of an AMF soldier and the wounding of two service members.","spans":["src:c6e54c0e15c9#p25.4"]},{"id":"F6","kind":"situation","status":"confirmed","fact":"The Commander had wanted the battalion to begin the inquiry locally; the incident site was difficult to reach from regimental headquarters, a regimental investigator would take three to four days to reach it, and the battalion was already there.","spans":["src:c6e54c0e15c9#p25.2"]},{"id":"F7","kind":"authority","status":"assessed","fact":"The Commander testified that he did not know Army regulations required a GCMCA to appoint the investigator or that the Army Safety Center had to be notified, and believed he was acting within his authority based on guidance from attorneys and a lieutenant colonel.","spans":["src:c6e54c0e15c9#p25.3"]},{"id":"F8","kind":"capability","status":"assessed","fact":"The battalion commander selected the most senior battalion member available at the forward operating base as investigating officer and believed that officer was qualified.","spans":["src:c6e54c0e15c9#p24.5"]}],"options":{"O1":{"do":"The Commander approves the battalion investigator’s draft as the completed AR 15-6 inquiry.","move":"act","disposition":"approve","irreversible":false},"O2":{"do":"The Commander rejects the battalion investigator’s draft and appoints a senior regimental investigator for the inquiry.","move":"act","disposition":"reject","irreversible":false},"O3":{"do":"The Commander returns the draft to the battalion investigator for revision and completion of the inquiry.","move":"act","disposition":"return","irreversible":false}},"opposite_pair":["O1","O2"],"real_option":"O2","authored_options":["O1","O3"],"no_opposite_reason":""}
